summary.headline: Planet Joined to the Lord of the Year
summary.text: Chapter XIX explains how to judge the planet joined to the lord of the year, including confidence and fear, the significator of the king, the midheaven and its lord, combustion, and the effects of benefic or malefic conjunctions on the king and rustics. It also interprets the part of fortune, luminaries, signs, and planetary impediments as signs of gain, loss, death, or royal obstruction.
